lead: A grapheme count does not decompose into one correction per seam, and regional indicators are the whole of why.
body: A cached `Core\Str::length` makes a concatenation want `left + right - (a cluster spans the join)`, right for every UAX #29 rule but GB12/GB13, which group a run of `Regional_Indicator`s into pairs: `"🇩" . "🇩🇪"` is two clusters where each side alone is one, and the parity that fixes two pieces is wrong for three. `nvs_runtime::graphemes::seam_joins` refuses the seam when a regional indicator sits on both sides and the caller leaves the count uncached; a cached aggregate over Unicode text may only be corrected locally for the rules that are local.
